'''James Joseph Ryan''' (born May 18, 1957) is an American former [[linebackers coach]] and former [[National Football League]] (NFL) [[linebacker]] for the [[Denver Broncos]].

Born in [[Bellmawr, New Jersey]], Ryan played high school football at [[Bishop Eustace Preparatory School]].<ref>[https://www.pro-football-reference.com/players/R/RyanJi20.htm Jim Ryan], [[Pro Football Reference]]. Accessed September 4, 2025. "Born: May 18, 1957 in Bellmawr, NJ (Age: 68-109d)]... High School: Bishop Eustace (NJ)"</ref>
